messages:
Aisha K: Quick note — we're piloting a tiny new kit called "15s Impact Lines" for the upcoming self-review cycle. The idea: give ICs 3 x 15-second scripts they can paste in: impact headline, what changed, and evidence. Trying to keep it terse.
Ben R: Love the idea. Can you share example lines? :eyes:
Aisha K: Sure — here are the first drafts:

```
Impact headline: Reduced inference latency by 35% for live traffic
What changed: Implemented adaptive batching + KV cache warming
Evidence: Median p50 down from 220ms -> 145ms, 99th from 900ms -> 430ms (query logs + perf dashboard)
```

Claire M: These feel useful. Suggest adding a one-line 'blocked-by' note for managers to triage later.
Aisha K: Good call. New micro-template below — manager-facing and IC-facing variants.

IC variant (paste into self-review):
`Headline — action — metric/evidence [optional blocker]`

Manager prompt (paste into manager feedback):
`What to praise: specific effect, who it helped, suggested next step`

Ben R: Can we also make a 30s spoken version for 1:1s? Short bullets people can read aloud.
Aisha K: Yes — drafted two spoken lines per item. Also planning a tiny acceptance rubric for pilots: "clear", "measurable", "manager-ready".
Claire M: How long is the pilot and who signs up?
Aisha K: Two weeks. Looking for 6 volunteers across Eng/Product/Docs. Reply here to join. :raised_hand:
Ben R: I'm in — will try to use it in my next self-review.
people-ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: pilot kickoff meeting tomorrow 10:00am PT — calendar invite sent.
Aisha K: Thanks! I'll post a short checklist and a Google doc with editable examples after the kickoff. If anyone has promo copy for the team, drop it here.
Claire M: I'll draft a 1-liner for the team announcement — 30 chars max for the channel. will post shortly.
Aisha K: Awesome — and if pilot goes well we'll add templates to the performance guide and manager onboarding.
Ben R: Quick Q — will templates include tag for manager to copy into calibration notes?
Aisha K: Yes — adding a tiny note: `for-calibration: yes/no` so it's easy to grep in docs.
Claire M: :thumbsup:
